subject: Clearwell: security intake & air-gapped deployment feasibility
messages:
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@clearwell.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Clearwell: security intake & air-gapped deployment feasibility

Hi Alice — great call earlier today, thanks for walking us through Clearwell's use case. Recap and ask: 

TL;DR: Clearwell is evaluating a private/offline deployment of Redwood for PII/HIPA A workloads; primary asks are SOC 2 evidence, HIPAA attestation, and whether we can deliver an air-gapped/on-prem package with an initial network isolation diagram.

What I captured: 
- Workload: ingestion + realtime inference on PHI-derived documents, throughput moderate (~5–10 qps peak).
- Constraint: no persistent outbound internet from inference hosts; procurement prefers an air-gapped or controlled VPC with no egress to public internet.
- Timeline: initial PO target by end of Q3, technical deep-dive next week if feasible.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Can you share SOC 2 Type II (or summary) and HIPAA compliance statement or point of contact for legal/security?
2) We'll draft a short vendor security questionnaire (we already have a template) — would you prefer we send it to security_ops@clearwell.com?
3) Schedule a focused technical session with our solutions engineer (network + ops) to validate air-gap options and deployment pattern (VPC-only vs fully air-gapped appliance). Two slots I can offer: Tue 30 Jun 09:00–10:00 PT or Wed 1 Jul 13:00–14:00 PT.

Attachments I will share after internal alignment: proposed network diagram + preliminary questionnaire (TBD).

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

—
Ethan Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Alice Park <alice.park@clearwell.com>

Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:23:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Clearwell: security intake & air-gapped deployment feasibility

Hi Ethan — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers and context from our security team: 

- SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type II report for our core services. We can't publish the full report publicly, but we can share a redacted copy under NDA. See attached: clearwell-soc2-summary.pdf (redacted summary).
- HIPAA: Clearwell operates under a BAA with customers; attached is a short HIPAA attestation and our security contact card (clearwell-hipaa-statement.pdf).
- Air-gap requirement: our InfoSec lead says fully air-gapped is preferred for PHI-heavy workloads. That said, we are open to an initial VPC-deployed model with strict egress controls if the vendor provides an offline install path and documented transport media procedures.

I've looped security_ops@clearwell.com to pick up the vendor questionnaire. Please send it there; prefer XLSX format. We can also provide network constraints and an internal requirements doc prior to the deep dive.

Wed 1 Jul 13:00–14:00 PT works for us — please send a calendar invite with dial-in and the proposed diagram attached.

Regards,
Alice Park
Head of IT Security, Clearwell HealthTech
alice.park@clearwell.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Clearwell: security intake & air-gapped deployment feasibility — internal plan

Folks — quick internal note before we send final package to Clearwell. Summary of options and recommended ask for the technical deep-dive: 

Options we can support (high level):
- VPC isolated deployment (preferred path for speed): private subnets, strict egress via NAT/egress gateways, no public IPs on inference hosts; requires peering or private link from Clearwell network. Pros: faster onboarding, cloud-managed updates. Cons: still outbound connectivity unless we implement strict egress filters and proxy.
- Air-gapped on-prem appliance / ISO installer (fully offline): we can provide signed installer bundle + offline KV import/export tooling and an offline model packaging process. Pros: meets strictest policy. Cons: longer ops lift, manual patching, potential SLA differences.
- Hybrid (initial VPC, migration to air-gap): start with VPC to validate workload, then deliver offline migration plan with transport media and verification steps.

For the 1 Jul call, recommend we: 
1) Share the attached proposed diagram (rwi-proposed-airgap-diagram-v1.png) that shows both VPC and air-gap variants.
2) Send XLSX vendor questionnaire (attached vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx) to security_ops@clearwell.com ahead of the call so they can fill the answers and we can annotate.
3) Assign Priyom as solutions lead for the deep dive (network + deployment owner).

I'll draft a short email to Alice with attachments and the meeting invite — Ethan, if you can confirm the time (you have calendar hold), I'll send it.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Alice — attaching the items we discussed for the 1 Jul technical session. Attachments: vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx (please fill and return), rwi-proposed-airgap-diagram-v1.png (two variant views: VPC-only and fully-offline), and a short checklist for air-gap validation.

Confirmed: Wed, 1 Jul 2026, 13:00–14:00 PT. Dial-in and calendar invite sent (check calendar). Priyom will lead the technical deep-dive, Neha will cover deployment options and offline installer details. 

Questions for the call (to help focus):
- Which egress functions (updates, telemetry, license checks) must be offline for your environment?
- Would Clearwell accept signed bundles delivered via SFTP or physical media for initial model weights and images?
- Is there an internal PO/contract milestone tied to SOC 2 evidence or BAA execution?

Thanks again — we'll be prepared to present the air-gap migration plan and show the offline installer workflow.

Best,
Ethan Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
